parsed.notes:
Only Dein Profil supplies candidate requirements; technologies named solely in Deine Aufgaben were excluded.
The Managed Kubernetes examples are optional because of idealerweise. Only OpenShift has a taxonomy entry, so no single-member alternative group is emitted for that list.
Terraform, Argo CD, Helm and unmapped Kustomize are read literally as alternatives in the example list ending in oder; mapped members form group 1. PostgreSQL and MongoDB form group 2.
Unmapped logging, alerting, automated deployments, TLS/certificates and troubleshooting are retained as explicitly requested technical practices rather than inferred taxonomy matches. Audit logging is separately named.
Kubernetes-/Cloud-Security and Container-/Image-Security map to cybersecurity; IAM/RBAC and Least-Privilege-Prinzipien collapse into access-control.
The degree has no stated level, so bachelor applies. IT-Ausbildung is explicitly accepted instead of university study, making degree_or_equivalent true.
Fundierte Erfahrung and Umfangreiche Kenntnisse do not establish seniority under the guide.
